info.title: Shotmap API
info.description: Read-only football shot data. Data by StatsBomb. Every response carries the data release it comes from and the attribution to show.

get.summary: The data release, its source and size, the competitions with their seasons, and the stage names
get.description: Start here: `release` in the body is the value to pass as `v` on every other request.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: The data release you expect. Matching the current release makes the answer cacheable for a year; any other release answers 410 `release_gone`.

schema.description: The data release you expect. Matching the current release makes the answer cacheable for a year; any other release answers 410 `release_gone`.

200.description: The data, wrapped with the release and the attribution.

ETag.description: A strong validator: the release plus a hash of the path and query. Send it back as If-None-Match to get a 304.

Cache-Control.description: public, max-age=31536000, immutable when the request names the current release with ?v=<release>; otherwise public, max-age=300, s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400.

X-Data-Release.description: The data release, the same value as `release` in the body.

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag is still current.

400.description: The request is malformed, or asks for too many rows.

get.summary: A player's shots across matches, as columns
get.description: Sorted by match, then seq. Never more than `limit` rows (at most 10000); `truncated` says whether there were more, and the rows are the first ones. `season` needs `competition`. Open play and the shootout are both included unless `period` says otherwise.
